instruction.text: The first clock shows when Ella started painting. The second shows when she finished. How long did Ella spend painting? Fill in the gaps.
The first clock shows when Gordon started making a sculpture. The second shows when he finished. How long did Gordon spend making the sculpture? Fill in the gaps.
The first clock shows when Felix started drawing. The second shows when he finished. How long did Felix spend drawing? Fill in the gaps.
Which took longer to make between Ella’s painting, Gordon’s sculpture and Felix’s drawing? Order the lengths of time shown from shortest to longest. Put the shortest length of time at the top.

trainers.instruction: Alec is talking about his plans for the weekend. Read along with the text while he speaks.

atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '+0.8st'> On Saturday from 11am to 4.15 pm, I will play with my dog in the park. On Sunday from 10.15am to 6.45pm, I will visit my grandparents.</prosody>

atoms.b: Alec will be playing with his dog in the park for ((4_and_a_half_hours ++5_hours_and_15_minutes 6_hours)).
Alec will be at his grandparents’ for ((++8_hours_and_30_minutes 8_hours_and_20_minutes 8_hours_and_40_minutes)).
Alec will spend ((++3_hours_and_15_minutes 3_hours 3_hours_and_30_minutes)) more at his grandparents’ than he will playing with his dog this weekend.
